content: JSON Schema evolution: additionalProperties:false creates a closed content model that breaks the moment the producer (gsd-core) adds a new key the consumer schema doesn't know. The robustness-principle fix is to treat the schema as open on read (ignore/round-trip unknown properties, never error or strip them) while being conservative on write (only emit properties you understand). unevaluatedProperties (2019-09+) is needed instead of additionalProperties when schemas are composed via allOf/. Backward compatibility is maintained by only adding optional fields, never removing/narrowing types, and never retroactively adding additionalProperties:false.
